name: @macrolog/core
description: Shared framework-free brain (domain types + pure math) for the Ignia PWA and Expo app.
//: `exports` used to be a wildcard ("./*": "./src/*.ts"), which republished
all ~90 modules and quietly undid the curation in src/index.ts. This map is
explicit so the barrel's curation is enforced instead of merely documented:
a deep import of anything not listed below now fails to resolve.
THE RULE for adding a subpath here: a module earns a deep-import path only
when the barrel cannot hand you the symbol. src/index.ts has two tiers --
74 modules are `export *` (their whole surface is already at
'@macrolog/core', so they need NO entry here), and 13 are exported through
curated `export { ... }` blocks that deliberately withhold the rest, almost
always colliding type names (CONTEXT.md calls out workout.ts). Those 13 have
no barrel path to the withheld half, so they are listed below. If you add a
module to src/index.ts as `export *`, do NOT add it here. If you add one as a
curated named block, add it here and say which names the barrel withholds.
The last two entries (activity-level, tdee) are GRANDFATHERED and break that
rule: both are `export *` in the barrel, so their deep imports are redundant.
They are here only because two call sites in apps/mobile/src/__tests__ already
use them and constraint #1 is that nothing breaks. Move those two imports to
'@macrolog/core' and delete these two lines; do not add more like them.
Deliberately NOT listed, so they stay private: index.ts's own internals, plus
restaurant-chains.data.ts and tdee.test-utils.ts.
No build step: these point at .ts source on purpose (ADR-0012) -- core is
consumed as TypeScript by the Angular app, Metro and the Node scripts alike.
Import extensionless ('@macrolog/core/cardio'); the '.ts' is supplied here.
CAVEAT for the next person: the repo-root tsconfig.json still maps
"@macrolog/core/*" -> "packages/core/src/*" in `paths`, and a tsconfig path
mapping wins over this map. So this restriction is enforced for apps/mobile
(whose tsconfig has no such mapping) but NOT for the Angular app in src/.
src/ has zero deep imports today; drop that root `paths` line to close the
hole. functions/ is not a workspace and cannot import core at all (ADR-0012).
